# Issue #112: bucket exceeds capacity after idle period

After the bucket sits idle for a while, `allow()` lets through more requests than
`capacity`. Refill must be capped at `capacity`. There is also a second bug: the
very first call after construction should succeed even if `now()` returns 0.
Fix `limiter/bucket.py`.


Repository files:
limiter/__init__.py
limiter/bucket.py
tests/test_bucket.py

1| import time
   2| 
   3| class TokenBucket:
   4|     """Classic token bucket. `rate` tokens are added per second up to `capacity`.
   5|     `allow()` consumes one token and returns True, or returns False if empty."""
   6| 
   7|     def __init__(self, capacity: int, rate: float, now=time.monotonic):
   8|         self.capacity = capacity
   9|         self.rate = rate
  10|         self._now = now
  11|         self._tokens = float(capacity)
  12|         self._last = None
  13| 
  14|     def _refill(self):
  15|         t = self._now()
  16|         if self._last:
  17|             self._tokens += (t - self._last) * self.rate
  18|         self._last = t
  19| 
  20|     def allow(self) -> bool:
  21|         self._refill()
  22|         if self._tokens >= 1:
  23|             self._tokens -= 1
  24|             return True
  25|         return False

   3| class TokenBucket:
   4|     """Classic token bucket. `rate` tokens are added per second up to `capacity`.
   5|     `allow()` consumes one token and returns True, or returns False if empty."""
   6| 
   7|     def __init__(self, capacity: int, rate: float, now=time.monotonic):
   8|         self.capacity = capacity
   9|         self.rate = rate
  10|         self._now = now
  11|         self._tokens = float(capacity)
  12|         self._last = None
  13| 
  14|     def _refill(self):
  15|         t = self._now()
  16|         # Only refill if we've recorded a previous time (None is allowed and 0 is valid).
  17|         if self._last is not None:
  18|             self._tokens += (t - self._last) * self.rate
  19|             # Do not exceed capacity when refilling.
  20|             if self._tokens > self.capacity:
  21|                 self._tokens = float(self.capacity)
  22|         self._last = t
  23| 
  24|     def allow(self) -> bool:
  25|         self._refill()
  26|         if self._tokens >= 1:
  27|             self._tokens -= 1
  28|             return True
  29|         return False

arguments.summary: Fixed token refill and initial-time handling in limiter/bucket.py. Changed _refill to only skip refill when _last is None (so a timestamp of 0 is treated as valid) and capped tokens at capacity after adding refilled tokens to prevent overfilling.
